g.text: B Exact gain exceeds the frozen target

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: D4 augmentation makes 32 positive acquisitions reliably sufficient

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: SUPPORTED for all 4 fixed fits: ≥90% reliability and ≥10 percentage-point paired improvement

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: BP AdamW fits fixed · 32 raw positive labels per arm · D4 adds 256 attempted correlated views and a symmetry prior

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: D4 success probability is 96.044282% for every fit. Probability of raw success becoming D4 failure is exactly zero.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: D4 invariance is supplied as an additional prior. The views are deduplicated and correlated; they are not 256 independent labels.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Pure learner sees only its selected positives/model/classes. The evaluator alone scans the full 1,932-board source population.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Full joint raw/D4 union probabilities: all 1,792 paired masks retained, 32 distinct supports, independent grouped-DP check.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Same seen 831,605-key N15 universe. Fixed-fit repair reliability; no refit, search-performance or fresh-generalization claim.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Whole stage: 8.162 CPU s / 8.178 wall s; 0 GPU s. Improvement is in raw-label use under the D4 prior.
